mapper.select: SELECT i.inquiry_id, i.title, i.content, i.is_secret, i.is_answered, i.created_at, i.created_by, u.username, u.phone, p.name AS product_name, a.title AS answer_title, a.content AS answer_content, a.created_at AS answer_created_at FROM inquiry i LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = i.created_by LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN inquiry a ON a.upper_inquiry_id = i.inquiry_id WHERE i.inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_review (product_id, product_variant_id, user_id, rating, content, status, created_at) VALUES (#{productId}, #{productVariantId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content}, 'VISIBLE', NOW())
INSERT INTO product_review_image (product_review_id, url, sort_order) VALUES (#{productReviewId}, #{url}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT url FROM product_review_image WHERE product_review_id = #{productReviewId} ORDER BY sort_order
SELECT review_count AS totalCount, avg_rating AS averageRating FROM product_review_stats WHERE product_id = #{productId}

SELECT r.product_review_id AS reviewId, r.product_id AS productId, r.content AS content, r.rating AS rating, r.user_id AS createdBy, r.created_at AS createdAt, u.email AS email FROM product_review r LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} AND r.status = 'VISIBLE'
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_review_image i WHERE i.product_review_id = r.product_review_id)
ORDER BY r.rating DESC, r.created_at DESC
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO product_review_stats (product_id, avg_rating, review_count, rating_1_cnt, rating_2_cnt, rating_3_cnt, rating_4_cnt, rating_5_cnt) SELECT r.product_id, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 1), COUNT(*), SUM(r.rating >= 1 AND r.rating < 2), SUM(r.rating >= 2 AND r.rating < 3), SUM(r.rating >= 3 AND r.rating < 4), SUM(r.rating >= 4 AND r.rating < 5), SUM(r.rating >= 5) FROM product_review r WHERE r.product_id = #{productId} AND r.status = 'VISIBLE' GROUP BY r.product_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE avg_rating = VALUES(avg_rating), review_count = VALUES(review_count), rating_1_cnt = VALUES(rating_1_cnt), rating_2_cnt = VALUES(rating_2_cnt), rating_3_cnt = VALUES(rating_3_cnt), rating_4_cnt = VALUES(rating_4_cnt), rating_5_cnt = VALUES(rating_5_cnt)
